basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Raebareli Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Technical Support III, Project Nurse I Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli (AIIMS Raebareli) has notified 2 vacancies for Project Technical Support-III (PTS-III) and Project Nurse-I posts on a contract basis. The engagement is purely temporary and project-based initially for one year, carrying pay of Rs. 28,000 + HRA as admissible for Project Technical Support-III (PTS-III) and Rs. 18,000 + HRA as admissible for Project Nurse-I. Qualifications vary according to the post as specified in the official notification under advertisement number AIIMS/ RBL/ PMR/ 2026-27 / 111. Eligible candidates must submit their filled app

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form in the prescribed format provided in the notification.
Compile your updated CV, self-attested copies of all relevant mark-sheets, certificates, and documents relating to research or other relevant experience together as a single PDF file.
Send the application via email to [email protected] on or before 19-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM.
Set the subject line of the email strictly as: “Application for the post of ………… – ICMR Project.”

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli
Role of Platelet-Rich Fibrin and Off-Loading in Diabetic Foot Ulcer Management: A Randomised Controlled Trial
Initially for one year (purely temporary and project-based)
Project Technical Support-III (PTS-III) and Project Nurse-I
Rs. 28,000/- (Project Technical Support-III) / Rs. 18,000/- (Project Nurse-I) + HRA as admissible

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: *As on last date of receipt of applications, age relaxation as per applicable ICMR rules.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: 1. Project Technical Support-III (PTS-III): Essential Qualification: Three-year Graduate Degree in Life Sciences/ related subject or field with three years' post-qualification experience in the relevant field OR Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences/related subject or field. Desirable Qualification/Experience: Experience in clinical research, patient recruitment and follow-up, clinical data collection and management, maintenance of research records, data entry and handling and proficiency in computer applications, or work in a hospital/clinical research setting. Experience in the field of diabetic foot, diabetic neuropathy, diabetic foot ulcer management, neurorehabilitation, wound care or other related areas will be preferred. 2. Project Nurse-I: Essential Qualification: Two-year Auxiliary Nurse & Midwife (ANM) course from a recognised institution. Desirable Qualification/Experience: Experience in patient care, wound care and dressing, plaster cast application/ assistance in cast application, patient counselling, clinical follow-up, data collection and handling and proficiency in computer applications. Experience in diabetic foot care, care of patients with diabetic neuropathy/insensate foot, foot-care education or related rehabilitation/clinical care will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raebareli Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form in the prescribed format provided in the notification. Compile your updated CV, self-attested copies of all relevant mark-sheets, certificates, and documents relating to research or other relevant experience together as a single PDF file. Send the application via email to [email protected] on or before 19-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM. Set the subject line of the email strictly as: “Application for the post of ………… – ICMR Project.”

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinized and shortlisted based on eligibility, qualifications, experience, and credentials. Only shortlisted and eligible candidates will be called for the screening and interview. Candidates attending the screening or interview must bring original certificates and documents in support of age, educational and professional qualifications, experience, and category, along with two recent passport-size colour photographs and one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary and project-based, initially for one year, subject to satisfactory performance, continuation of the project, and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the remuneration is ₹28,000/- for Project Technical Support-III and ₹18,000/- for Project Nurse-I, plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q3. Who receives age relaxation for these posts?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable as per the applicable ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q4. What subject line must be used when sending the application email?
faq.answer: The subject of the email must be: “Application for the post of ………… – ICMR Project.”

faq.question: Q5. Where will the screening and interviews take place?
faq.answer: The screening and interview will be held at the Department of PMR, AIIMS Raebareli on 21-10-2026 at 10:00 A.M.
